job.title: Business Systems Analyst- SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris)

tailoring.headline: Techno-Functional SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) Business Systems Analyst | SAP Certified
tailoring.summary: SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer with 5+ years of experience delivering enterprise e-commerce solutions for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Expert in bridging business requirements and technical execution, specializing in SAP Commerce Cloud (2105/2211), OCC REST APIs, and complex PIM/ERP/MDM integrations. Proven track record in requirements engineering, user story mapping, and AI-assisted solution design. Adept at optimizing data pipelines and ensuring system stability in high-traffic environments. Committed to driving business value through robust, scalable, and well-documented e-commerce architectures.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

keywords_missing: Specific industry domain expertise beyond manufacturing

cover_en.subject: Application: Business Systems Analyst- SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris)
cover_en.hook: As a SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer with over five years of experience delivering complex e-commerce solutions at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am eager to contribute to your team. My background in bridging the gap between business stakeholders and technical implementation makes me an ideal fit for your Business Systems Analyst role.

bullets.label: Techno-Functional Analysis
bullets.text: I have extensive experience translating complex business requirements into functional specifications and user stories for SAP Commerce Cloud, ensuring seamless alignment between business goals and technical delivery.

bullets.label: Integration Expertise
bullets.text: I have successfully designed and optimized data pipelines between PIM, ERP, and MDM systems, ensuring high data consistency and synchronization across global e-commerce channels.

bullets.label: API & Headless Delivery
bullets.text: I have developed and exposed OCC REST Web Services and headless APIs, enabling robust storefront functionality and third-party integrations within the SAP Commerce ecosystem.

bullets.label: AI-Driven Efficiency
bullets.text: I leverage generative AI tools to accelerate requirements analysis, documentation, and solution design, significantly improving the speed and accuracy of the development lifecycle.

cover_en.logistics: I am based in Karlsruhe and hold a valid German residence and work permit. I am currently serving a notice period and will be available to start on 16 December 2026. I look forward to discussing how my experience can support your team.

tailoring.why_company: Rockwell Automation is a global leader in industrial automation, and I am deeply impressed by your commitment to digital transformation in the e-commerce space. Having worked within your ecosystem, I admire the scale and complexity of your platforms. I am eager to bring my techno-functional expertise to your team to help refine business processes, optimize integration architectures, and ensure that your SAP Commerce solutions continue to drive exceptional value for your global customers.
tailoring.motivation_short: I am motivated by the challenge of solving complex integration problems and translating business needs into high-performing SAP Commerce solutions. I thrive in international environments where I can bridge the gap between technical teams and business stakeholders.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Dear Hiring Team, I am a SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer with 5+ years of experience at Rockwell Automation and Shell. I am interested in the Business Systems Analyst role and believe my techno-functional background is a strong match. My CV and cover letter are attached.
tailoring.email_subject: Application: Business Systems Analyst - Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my CV and cover letter for the Business Systems Analyst position at Rockwell Automation. With over five years of experience in SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) and a strong background in techno-functional analysis and system integration, I am confident in my ability to contribute to your team's success. I am available to start on 16 December 2026 and would welcome the opportunity to discuss my qualifications in an interview. Thank you for your time and consideration.
